prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. Over the course of nineteen visits, care consisted of physical therapy, a home exercise program, and anti-inflammatory medication. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of a rear-end impact of this type. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward functional levels. Examination findings include limited elevation and tenderness along the rotator cuff, which support the reported injury, while neurological screening and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the right shoulder is known. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries.
